question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Chhivalrous"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given three words are correct without one which is **Chhivalrous.**
 
• There is a word that is **Chivalrous**. A chivalrous person is one who is considerate and careful. **Chhivalrous** is not a correctly spelt word.
 
• Let's see a sentence as an example.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a **c****hivalrous** man.
 
 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's see the other options which are given in the question.
 
• If a person does anything bad or wicked, you should call it nefarious. So **"Nefarious"** is the correct word.
 
• **Sermonise** is a lengthy speech intended to instruct listeners on how to conduct themselves in order to become better persons. This is a verb form in English.
 
• A court's finding of innocence is known as an **acquittal**.
